methodology.directNavigation: Each attempt navigated directly to record.embedUrl.
methodology.resultFrameRequirement: Waited for iframe[name=result] or a frame hosted at fiddle.jshell.net, then inspected that frame document.
methodology.meaningfulContentRule: Trimmed visible body text, any canvas/svg/img/video/audio element, or any visible non-script body descendant.

classificationRules.verified: Result frame loaded with meaningful content and no uncaught page error.
classificationRules.rendered-with-errors: Result frame loaded with meaningful content and one or more uncaught page errors.
classificationRules.empty: Result frame loaded without meaningful content.
classificationRules.blocked: HTTP access status or challenge/access-denied content prevented result-frame inspection.
classificationRules.timeout: Bounded navigation or result-frame inspection timed out.
classificationRules.failed: Other navigation or runtime failure prevented result-frame inspection.

methodology.retryRule: Every first attempt not classified verified was retried exactly once; final classification is the last attempt.
methodology.ignoredRuntimeRequestRule: Failed requests matching Cloudflare analytics/beacon endpoints are excluded from failedRuntimeRequests and retained in ignoredFailedRequests.
